payload.summary: Docling lab fixtures.v2 table-hardness corpus: add unruled, merged-cell, and rotated-header tables so the Gate B table-heavy improvement leg has measurable headroom
payload.detail: The v1 corpus's table strata are cleanly ruled grids on which the legacy extractor already scores cell F1 1.0 (S6 smoke run and the S6b Gate B run), so the pre-agreed table-heavy improvement target was set to 0 pp (parity at ceiling) by owner decision on 2026-08-18. Before any table-heavy delta is treated as decisive for a Docling promotion beyond B4 shadow design, add a docling-lab-fixtures.v2 stratum set where the legacy find_tables path is expected to degrade: unruled tables, merged cells, rotated headers. Fixture-hardness change only — eval/docling/ manifest + generator, no worker or extractor edit. See eval/docling/README.md 'Known limitation (v1 corpus)' and docs/rag-improvement/gate-b-decision-record-2026-08-18.md.
payload.source: packet S6b (Gate B run), owner threshold decision 2026-08-18
